about: Reports how far a task has come as a ring, with the value in its middle. The ring is the progress bar a screen reader reports, and the label names it. For a value the machine does not know, a quarter arc turns.

counted.about: `max` counts the steps. The ring's middle shows `3/5` as children of the value text, and `aria-valuetext` on the ring states the count in words.
counted.title: Counting steps

layout.about: Stacked puts the label under the ring. Inline puts it beside the ring, as in a list row.
layout.title: Layouts

palette.about: The scene crosses every palette with both looks. The outline look strokes the track in the muted ground, and the subtle look in the palette's muted role.
palette.title: Palettes and looks

shape.about: `shape` rounds or squares the ends of the range. The scene shows both on the thickest ring.
shape.title: Shapes

size.about: The ring is 24, 32, 40, 48 and 64px wide and 4, 4, 4, 6 and 8px thick. From `md` up the value shows in the ring's middle, in the largest text style whose "100%" fits inside the ring. The smaller rings hide it. The ring's `aria-valuetext` states the value at every size.
size.title: Sizes

title: Progress circle

unknown.about: A `null` value means the end is not known. A quarter arc turns once every 1.2 seconds, and the ring leaves out `aria-valuenow`. For a reader who asked for less motion, the ring stops and the range is a dashed line around the whole ring.
unknown.title: Value unknown

units.about: `max` sets the range in gigabytes. The middle shows the share, and `aria-valuetext` states the amount used.
units.title: Counting in its own units
